test_keyboard_press: test the Keyboard.press method to simulate pressing a key with optional delay
test_keyboard_type: test the Keyboard.type method to type text with optional delay between keystrokes
test_mouse_click: test the Mouse.click method to click at specified x, y coordinates with button and delay options
test_mouse_dblclick: test the Mouse.dblclick method to double-click at specified x, y coordinates
test_touchscreen_tap: test the Touchscreen.tap method to simulate a tap at specified x, y coordinates
